digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler and bridge exit-code adapter
propositions: Canonical preview/sync routes must emit only exit codes 0 (success/benign/paused/yield/reschedule), 1 (operational failure), and 2 (invalid invocation/configuration) while legacy reconcile routes retain historical codes 3/4/75
A single typed disposition object must be consumed by both canonical and legacy adapters, with separate numeric translation only at the outer exit boundary
Production workflows and automation (systemd units, Jenkins, scripts, checked-out repositories) consuming legacy 3/4/75 codes must continue working without modification or whitelist changes

Both canonical and legacy adapters must run the reconciliation pass exactly once, preserve repository/ref mutations according to existing semantics (preview non-mutating, sync mutating, paused skips commit-and-push), and share the same core result boundary
